title: Stream Event
description: Provider-neutral turn progress event. Rendered from structured summary fields; raw provider payloads and raw tool output are never forwarded.

seq.description: Monotonic within a turn. Used as the resume cursor for re-attachment; replay produces no duplicate side effect.

text.description: Redacted assistant delta. Present only for assistant.delta.

summary.description: Bounded structured summary. Never raw arguments, stdout, or stderr.

terminal.description: True on the final event of a stream, including a stream closed because the backlog window elapsed. A stream is never truncated silently.
